NaAudio__SampleLibraryIndex__Categories.Description: Machine drum kits. Six mapped voices per kit, bound to a sequencer as a unit.
Recorded acoustic kits, same six-voice map as the electronic kits.
Bongos, congas and djembe. Kit-mapped so a percussion lane drops onto a sequencer unchanged.
Salamander Grand Piano sampled at minor thirds. Pitch-shifted between sample points by the sample player.
Analogue and FM synth hits, pads and basses. Raw material for the CubeMod and DelayCloud demos.
Claps, bells, blocks and impacts. Struck-object material for the percussive lanes.
